stage: Local native-brush iteration on the V5 face source
visible_result: Upper lids cover more of the iris and the outer orbital transition is less abrupt than the rejected first brush trial.
The nasal base and upper lip have small local changes; the source face remains visually dominant.
Iris and pupil geometry were adjusted separately, so the eye appearance change is not all attributable to sculpting.
remaining_art_issues: The face still lacks the intended delicate xianxia identity.
Eye expression, brow forms and nose-to-lip relationship need further coordinated shaping.
Jaw and cheek transitions remain firmer than the design reference.
Neutral gray material does not establish final skin, eyebrow or eyelash quality.

revision_handling.reverted: Six initial native brush passes were reverted after visible canthal creases and a unified-size override were identified.
revision_handling.retained: Nine subsequent native brush passes contribute to three independent high-resolution shape keys.
revision_handling.post_sculpt_protection: Nose/lip deltas near the internal mouth seam were attenuated to zero using the documented protection mask; source interior vertices were restored.

technical_limits: The source contains existing mouth-region crossings; this is not a cleaned production head.
The additional intersection check covers the selected face patch, with tangencies and coplanar overlap excluded.
Live high-resolution sculpt changes have not been transferred back to the low-resolution source cage.
No facial expressions, blink, rig, skinning, game export or Estella acceptance were completed.
next_work: Continue face identity and mouth-interior cleanup before moving to hair, clothing or skin detail.
